feature: Reusable SSH key library in Preferences and saved-key selection during server setup.
migration: Existing per-endpoint encrypted keys migrate atomically before network configuration, retaining their original Android Keystore ciphertext.
behavior: named keys and public SHA-256 fingerprints
saved key selection, no-key mode, paste and file import
server selection remains a draft until Save & connect
forgetting a server retains the shared key
deleting a key confirms removal and clears only its bindings
unassigned key import and rename do not restart connections
